response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 10+ years across web, backend, and some embedded work, and has demonstrable strengths in low-latency, event-driven, distributed systems (D-lang microservices handling millions of req/s) plus strong testing and mentoring credentials. However, the role is fundamentally a C++/STL architecture position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project; the last decade has been JavaScript/TypeScript/Node/D. There is no evidence of Secure Development Lifecycle or IEC 62443 work, no MQTT or industrial protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), and no automation/OT domain background. The transferable skills are real but the core technical requirement and the mandated security expertise are both unmet, making him a poor fit for a mid-senior C++ specialist hire.
strengths: 10+ years senior/staff experience with strong high-performance, concurrent, event-driven systems background
Proven mentoring, workshops, TDD/CI-CD craftsmanship and documentation/communication skills
Broad polyglot full-stack range including Node.js, React, Docker/Kubernetes and IoT-adjacent embedded work
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and roughly a decade out of date
No SDL or IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity experience whatsoever
No MQTT, message-broker or industrial protocol/automation domain exposure
